items.title: SYK Q3 deep dive: Orthopedics softness, margin pressure, and product launches shape outlook
items.summary: Medical technology company Stryker (NYSE:SYK) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, but sales rose 7.6% year on year to $6.52 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.52 per share was 0.8% below analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Stryker (SYK) Stock Fair Value Falls After Analysts Reset Expectations Following Q3 Guidance
items.summary: Stryker is now modeled with a Fair Value of about US$351, down from roughly US$369, which points to a lower price target in the latest update. This reset lines up with recent Street commentary that trims expectations after Q3 results and guidance, while still viewing Stryker as a quality MedTech stock with execution questions rather than a broken story.
